# Homestyler

> > Homestyler is an AI-powered interior design platform where users create, share, and showcase room designs across multiple styles including American retro, contemporary, and shabby chic.

The platform hosts design challenges like bootcamp competitions and the AIDA Global AI Design Awards, featuring work from designers worldwide including Ekaterin, Cecilia Botha, and Marwa Abdelbast. Users can create 3D room designs, floor plans, and AI-generated interiors for spaces ranging from bedrooms and living rooms to kitchens and home offices.

## Key Topics

- AI interior design
- Room design showcase
- American retro style
- Contemporary design
- Shabby chic aesthetic
- Bedroom design
- Living room layouts
- Design challenges and competitions
- Bootcamp challenge
- 3D room visualization
- User design portfolios
- Kitchen and dining spaces
- Home office design
- International designer community
